segments.headline: Google's robot AI on a Mercedes-Benz line

beats.narration: Car factories need the right parts, in the right order, for every car. So can a humanoid robot do that job?
Google put its robot AI into humanoid robots on real Mercedes-Benz lines.
Their job: sorting parts from bins into trays, in each car's exact order.
The result: they got it right ninety-six percent of the time.
DeepMind calls that promising progress toward real-world use in factories.
Handing off this repetitive work, it says, frees technicians for more complex jobs.
That's DeepMind's own number, from a trial run whose size wasn't published.
